title: Magic Knight Rayearth Pilot
native: 魔法騎士（マジックナイト）レイアース パイロットフィルム
synopsis:
Included as a bonus feature on the Magic Knight Rayearth Memorial Collection Blu-ray set.

Note: This pilot was originally aired at FanimeCon on February 14, 1996. It was later officially released as part of the Blu-ray set released on October 29, 2014.
